name: Table Of Content Block – Auto-Generate Clickable Table of Contents
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Enhance your long-form content with the Table of Contents Block! 📚 This powerful WordPress plugin automatically generates a smart, interactive table of contents, making your content easy to navigate. It helps guide your readers effortlessly to the sections they’re interested in.Ideal for content creators, bloggers, and website owners, this tool transforms any lengthy article into a well-organized, user-friendly masterpiece.

Tired of losing readers in lengthy articles? Our Table of Contents Block is your solution! It automatically scans your content, identifies all headings, and creates a beautiful, clickable navigation menu that helps readers instantly jump to the sections they’re most interested in.

📌 Ideal For
✔ Blog Posts – Keep readers scrolling longer.
✔ Documentation & FAQs – Make help articles easier to navigate.
✔ Tutorials & Guides – Improve readability for step-by-step content.
✔ Knowledge Bases & Wikis – Organize long-form content like a pro.
✔ Affiliate & Review Sites – Help users find key sections faster.

What makes this plugin special? It’s not just a table of contents – it’s a complete content navigation system that:
• Works automatically – just add the block and watch the magic happen
• Stays synchronized with your content – updates in real-time as you edit
• Looks beautiful on all devices – fully responsive design
• Enhances reader engagement – keeps visitors on your page longer
• Improves SEO performance – helps search engines understand your content structure better

Whether you’re a blogger, content creator, or business owner, this plugin helps make your content more professional, accessible, and user-friendly. Give your readers the premium content experience they deserve!

Why choose Table of Contents Block?
Readers often get lost in lengthy content. This plugin helps guide them exactly where they want to go—improving navigation, boosting time-on-page, and enhancing the overall experience.

Table Of Content Block Features

  • Automatic Generation: The block automatically generates a TOC based on the headings in your post or page.

  • Customizable Styles: You can customize the appearance of TOC, including font, size, and colors.

  • Smooth Scrolling: Clicking on a table of contents entry smoothly scrolls the page to the corresponding heading.

  • Anchor Links: TOC entries are linked to the corresponding headings using anchor links.

  • Gutenberg Integration: The block seamlessly integrates with the Gutenberg editor, making it easy to add a table of contents to your content.

  • Responsive Design: TOC is designed to be responsive and adapt to different screen sizes.

Benefits:

  • Improved Navigation: Provides an easy way for visitors to navigate long-form content.

  • Enhanced User Experience: Makes it easier for visitors to find the information they are looking for.

  • SEO Optimization: Helps search engines understand the structure of your content, which can improve your SEO rankings.

How to use Table Of Content Block

  • First, install the Table Of Content Block plugin from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Add the Table Of Content Block from the block category called “widgets” in the Gutenberg editor.
  • You can change block settings from the right-side settings sidebar.

  • Enjoy!

  • For installation help click on Installation Tab

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For Table Of Content Block
  3. Click on the Table Of Content Block to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Table Of Content Block plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the table-of-content-block.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the Table Of Content Block plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
